ops.title: Serialize hook fire-count and consumed-ledger state across concurrent capt-hook processes
ops.description: Each hook event spawns a separate capt-hook run process; batched parallel tool calls all read the pre-increment fire_count (dispatch.py record_fire), so max_fires is not enforced under concurrency. Ledger evidence in ~/.cc-transcript/decisions.db: 3 identical warn rows in 112ms (session b5e38255, 2026-07-08) and 12 fires vs max_fires=3 (session 8a7b6ed4). The same race hits the consumed-text dedup in PrimitiveState.match_signals (state.py). Needs state-store transactionality (lock or CAS around per-session hook state). Found during the 8.15.0 signal-misfire fix; deliberately not bundled.

ops.text: a parallel dispatch regression test proves a max_fires=1 nudge fires at most once across a concurrent batch
consumed-text ledger updates are atomic across concurrent capt-hook processes
